# The Wi-Fi block of /metrics as reported in issue #435 by the owner of a
# camera whose Wi-Fi module is a Realtek RTL8189FS. Four readings arrive and
# the signal LEVEL is not among them: that driver offers no level in dBm, and
# a relative 0-100 number is not one — so the camera publishes no
# wifi_rssi_dbm rather than a figure with units it has not measured.
#
# This is the shape the Dashboard's Wi-Fi block could not draw: the fact line
# filled in from these four while the plot, fed by the absent fifth, stayed
# empty for the life of the page.
# HELP wifi_link_quality_ratio Wi-Fi link quality, percent of the driver's own maximum
# TYPE wifi_link_quality_ratio gauge
wifi_link_quality_ratio 70
# HELP wifi_retries_total Wi-Fi transmit retries
# TYPE wifi_retries_total counter
wifi_retries_total 0
# HELP wifi_missed_beacons_total Wi-Fi beacons missed from the associated AP
# TYPE wifi_missed_beacons_total counter
wifi_missed_beacons_total 0
# HELP wifi_bitrate_mbps Wi-Fi negotiated bitrate, Mbit/s
# TYPE wifi_bitrate_mbps gauge
wifi_bitrate_mbps 72.2
